items.headline: Cyclone Akvan disrupts air traffic, 14 flights cancelled in Ranchi
items.summary: As many as 14 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport in Ranchi on Saturday due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone 'Akvan', an official said. Jharkhand has been experiencing cloudy weather coupled with light rain since Friday under the influe…

items.headline: Transport sector outlook: Weak rail container volumes, subdued air traffic to weigh, JM Financial says
items.summary: JM Financial flags uneven recovery in India's transport sector, with weak rail container movement and subdued aviation demand despite strong EXIM growth.

items.headline: Delhi AQI remains 'poor' at 279, six stations record 'very poor' air
items.summary: Delhi's overall AQI stood at 279 at 7 am on Saturday, while Aiims and Chandni Chowk recorded readings above 360; the forecast points to a possible deterioration on Sunday

items.headline: India allows cut flower imports through Amritsar airport and Kandla seaport
items.summary: India has added Amritsar airport and Kandla seaport as entry points for cut flower imports, subject to mandatory plant quarantine inspection and certification.

items.headline: India must rethink aviation strategy to make airlines commercially viable
items.summary: Is there really a case for expanding Indian aviation when even a near-monopoly airline slips into losses at the slightest adverse turn in costs?

items.headline: (Not) up in the air: Travelers' trepidations spike as Thanksgiving nears and tech hiccups abound
items.summary: At this point, it’s practically as much of a Thanksgiving tradition as turkey and stuffing— crowded airports, long lines, jam-packed flights, the ever-present worry about delays and cancellations and extra expenses. And for 2026’s busy holiday travel week, th…

items.headline: Air India board holds meeting; discusses operational matters, fuel cost challenges: Sources
items.summary: The board of directors of loss-making Air India discussed various operational and financial matters, including issues related to rising fuel costs, during its meeting on Friday, according to sources.

items.headline: Threats, insults, settlements: How Jensen Huang made humiliation routine
items.summary: The Nvidia co-founder's belittling behavior toward employees goes back decades. It once led to a confidential settlement agreement with an executive who said Huang "terrorized" staff

items.headline: SpiceJet's ₹5,500 crore rescue bid runs into DGCA heat as fleet lies grounded
items.summary: The aviation regulator has questioned SpiceJet's ability to operate reliably, citing grounded aircraft, delays, cancellations and unpaid dues. The scrutiny comes as the airline seeks investments to fund a turnaround amid deep operational and financial stress.

items.headline: Parandur airport project: Madras HC orders notice to TN govt
items.summary: Bench of Chief Justice S A Dharmadhikari and Justice G Arul Murugan ordered notices to TNIDC, the Union Civil Aviation Ministry, and the AAI on a PIL by G Gouthaman

items.headline: Air India faces ₹22,000 crore loss: Tata Sons Board reviews airline's performance ahead of crucial meeting
items.summary: Tata Sons leaders reviewed Air India’s financial and operational challenges ahead of a board meeting. The airline lost more than ₹22,000 crore in FY2025-26, with fuel costs, airspace restrictions and aircraft delays adding pressure.

items.headline: DGCA issues show cause notice to SpiceJet over flight cancellations, delays
items.summary: Aviation watchdog DGCA has issued a show cause notice to crisis-hit SpiceJet seeking detailed responses on rising flight cancellations, operational disruptions due to delayed payments and certain violations, according to sources. The budget carrier, which saw…

items.headline: SpiceJet's ₹5,500-cr fundraise: Can it revive the airline's operations?
items.summary: The proposed ₹5,500-crore raise follows a sharp drop in market share, grounded aircraft and unpaid dues, raising questions about whether fresh capital can restore SpiceJet's operations

items.headline: SpiceJet faces over 7,600 passenger complaints amid widespread flight cancellations
items.summary: SpiceJet faces 7,674 passenger complaints amid flight cancellations, DGCA scrutiny and a cash crunch as the airline operates around 10 aircraft.

items.headline: AI is giving hackers a head start. What's at risk for essential services?
items.summary: Recent outages showed how much banks, hospitals and airlines rely on shared technology. CERT-In found AI cut impact time from days to hours in one campaign against Indian organisations

items.headline: Prestige launches 260 flats in North Bengaluru; 2 BHKs start at ₹1.73 crore
items.summary: Offering a selection of 2 and 3 BHK residences, Prestige Avon also features home offices in select layouts, catering to the evolving needs of urban homebuyers who increasingly seek flexible spaces

items.headline: Visa, Mastercard, JPMorgan customer data exposed in ransomware attack
items.summary: A ransomware group has leaked customer data linked to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Chase after targeting third-party service providers, exposing thousands of email addresses and some phone numbers

items.headline: ‘Everyone is a friend’: Trump’s Asia meetings reveal contrasting approaches to world order
items.summary: The US President’s whirlwind Asia trip brought together rival geopolitical groupings, raising questions about Washington’s evolving approach to global power equations

items.headline: JPMorgan reports cyberattack on third-party vendors, customer data potentially exposed
items.summary: JPMorgan reports a cyberattack on third-party vendors, with reports saying email addresses and phone numbers of around 16,000 wealthy customers were exposed.

items.headline: Trump's cyber chief Sean Cairncross to step down amid repeated tech outages
items.summary: Sean Cairncross reportedly does not wish to serve another two years in the role, Fox News reported, as disruptions hit Microsoft Outlook, United Airlines, major banks and US agencies

items.headline: IndiGo expands Southeast Asia flights from Delhi ahead of year-end holidays
items.summary: The airline will launch daily non-stop flights to Kuala Lumpur from December 20, while increasing frequencies on Delhi-Singapore and Delhi-Bangkok routes from December 20 and 28, respectively

items.headline: India's air safety radar picks up gaps in ageing ATC automation systems
items.summary: Delays in ATC modernisation, concerns over commercial TV screens and regulatory hurdles raise questions about India's air traffic management infrastructure

items.headline: Gwalior telecom manufacturing zone draws ₹3,600 cr investment proposals
items.summary: As many as 25 companies have expressed interest in the Gwalior telecom manufacturing zone; the second phase will cover 450.45 acres, with over 15,000 jobs expected from investments

items.headline: Weak rural indicators clouds second half outlook: BNP Paribas India
items.summary: BNP Paribas India cautions weak rural indicators and slower growth in H2 amid El Niño, inflation, and soft consumption, despite some relief from lower crude prices and robust credit.

items.headline: Amid widening losses, Air India pitches cost cuts to Tata Sons Board
items.summary: Tata Sons board members were briefed on Air India’s financial position, current cash burn and opportunities for closer integration with Air India Express on Thursday, a day before a crucial meeting in which further capital infusion is expected to be sought

items.headline: 74% SpiceJet flights cancelled at top 3 airports amid cash crunch
items.summary: SpiceJet cancelled 31 of 42 scheduled flights at Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru airports amid mounting financial stress, unpaid dues and operational difficulties.

items.headline: IndiGo expands South East Asia connectivity
items.summary: Daily Delhi-Kuala Lumpur from December 20; expansion amid free e-visas for ASEAN citizens

items.headline: Tata Sons board reviews Air India performance amid mounting losses
items.summary: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran and Noel Tata reviewed Air India's performance ahead of the airline's board meeting, where cost cuts and integration plans are likely to be discussed.

items.headline: India’s top 10 brands lose collective value as Airtel claims top spot, Meesho rises fastest
items.summary: In its annual ranking of India’s most valuable brands, Kantar said brand value of the top 10 fell collectively by 16%. Telecom provider Airtel claimed the top spot while value e-commerce platform Meesho rose the fastest to claim the 59th spot.

items.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first ever trilateral talks amid global tensions
items.summary: President Donald Trump met for more than an hour on Thursday with China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin, a moment that could mark a pivot in world history - or become a quickly forgotten photo op. Trump has promoted this first-ever three-way meeting …

items.headline: India’s crude oil demand to grow at 3% annually till 2035: IEA
items.summary: Rising transport, aviation, petrochemical and industrial needs are expected to drive India’s oil consumption even as advanced economies see declines.

items.headline: IndiGo cancels all flights to and from Saudi Arabia until November 30
items.summary: IndiGo has cancelled all flights to and from Jeddah, Madinah, Riyadh and Dammam until November 30, citing the security situation in Saudi Arabia.

items.headline: Good news for Dwarka, Najafgarh, Rohini residents! 8 new Delhi Metro corridors proposed under Phase V(B); check routes
items.summary: Delhi Metro Phase V(B) proposals include a corridor linking Yashobhoomi in Dwarka with Rajiv Chowk in Gurugram. Seven of eight proposed routes have Delhi government approval and are awaiting the Centre’s nod.

items.headline: Seven major tech incidents in a week – what’s going on, and what can we do?
items.summary: A cluster of global disruptions has renewed questions about the reliability of interconnected digital infrastructure and the resilience of essential services

items.headline: India’s diesel demand likely to sustain at 2.1-2.2 mb/d through December 2026
items.summary: Kpler expects industrial activity, agricultural requirements, freight movement and power generation needs to support petroleum product consumption through the year-end

items.headline: US tech outages linked to rush to fix AI-detected software vulnerabilities
items.summary: Microsoft, the FAA and the NSA have faced major service disruptions, with experts warning that rushing to fix software bugs found by AI could be putting computer systems under pressure
